# dsh-local-radiance-server-controller
A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: remote-control an AMD inference server on your local LAN over SSH —
the local Radiance inference server controller.
Adds a "推理服务器 / Inference Server" panel to the DSH sidebar plus an always-visible live-metrics widge
t in the sidebar footer, so day-to-day operations need no terminal.
Chinese documentation: README.zh-CN.md
Sidebar entry and the always-live metrics widget (bottom of the sidebar):
## Features
| Card | What it does | Remote command |
| SSH settings | Host / port / username / password / compose directory / default service file / imag
e name / power limit / sudo toggle | — (saved locally to `~/.dsh/dsh-local-radiance-server-controlle

r.json`) |
| AMD GPU power limit | Enable limit / reset to default; shows current limit state; butto
ns get a ✓ and disable when the state already matches | `sudo amd-smi set -o <W>` / `sudo amd-smi re

set -o` |
| Radiance inference service | Dropdown of yaml files in the compose directory (`common.ya
ml` hidden), start / stop / update image (down first, then pull); shows the running engine version;
opens the engine web page in your default browser | `cd <dir> && sudo docker compose -f <file> up -d
/ down`; `sudo docker pull <image>`; web URL = `http://<host>:<PORT>` with PORT read from `<compose

dir>/.env` |
| Server diagnostics | Fetch full amd-smi output | `amd-smi` |
| Danger zone | Shutdow
n / Reboot — each with its own two-click confirmation (auto-disarms after 4 s) | `sudo shutdown -h n

ow` / `sudo reboot` |
| Sidebar widget | One persistent row: status dot + `GPU %` `CPU %` decode/pre
fill t/s (shrinks to a status dot when the sidebar is collapsed) | see Live metrics below |
Opening the panel probes the server immediately (running services, power-limit state), then refreshe
s every 20 s; every action also triggers an immediate refresh.
## Live metrics & connection architecture
The whole plugin keeps exactly **one long-lived SSH connection** to the server (15 s keepalive, self
-healing reconnect with backoff). All traffic multiplexes over it through ssh2 exec channels:
| Traffic | Cadence | Remote command |
| Engine decode/prefill | 0.5 s | `curl localhost:<PORT>/stats` (radiance Web API; PORT and API key
are read on the fly from `<compose dir>/.env` — the key never leaves the server; the `version` field

doubles as the engine-version display on the service card) |
| CPU / GPU utilization | 5 s | `/proc

/stat` double-sample delta; `GFX_ACTIVITY` from `amd-smi metric -u` |
| Service / power state | 20 s
| `docker compose ls --format json`; `amd-smi static -l` (SOCKET vs MAX power to detect an active l

imit) |
| User actions | on demand | see Features table |
No short-lived connections: the server's `journalctl` typically shows only one or two SSH logins per
ort-lived connections: the server's `journalctl` typically shows only one or two SSH logins per day.
The sudo password is piped in via base64 (`base64 -d | sudo -S`); plaintext never appears in remote
is piped in via base64 (`base64 -d | sudo -S`); plaintext never appears in remote process arguments.
## Installation
### Prerequisites

- This machine: DeepSeek Harness desktop
- Server: sshd with password login, sudo available (Radianc
e deployed via docker compose; AMD GPU with `amd-smi`; radiance engine exposing the `/stats` endpoin
deployed via docker compose; AMD GPU with `amd-smi`; radiance engine exposing the `/stats` endpoint)
### Steps (first install on any machine)
1. **Copy the plugin directory** anywhere on the target machine (do **not** copy `node_modules`; rei

nstall dependencies per machine):
You only need `index.js`, `client.js`, `package.json`, `cordis.pat

ch.yml`, `icon.svg`, `locale/` (`assets/` is the README screenshot, optional).
2. **Install dependen
cies inside the plugin directory** (installing a local directory does not install its dependencies;
skipping this fails with `Cannot find package 'node-ssh'`):
[代码示例省略，未执行]

3. **Install the bundle into DSH**: tell the Harness agent
> use plugin_manager to install `<absolut
e plugin dir>` as a bundle

or run `dsh plugin install <absolute plugin dir>`.
4. **Restart the DSH app** (Host-side code loads

at app start).
5. Open the sidebar panel, fill in the SSH details, save.
To sync between machines, copy the files listed in step 1 and repeat steps 2–3.
## Configuration
| Field | Notes | Default |

| Host / port / username / password | SSH login (the password is also used for sudo) | `22` |
| Comp

ose directory | Directory containing the service yaml files (`~` allowed) | `~/radiance-compose` |
|

Default compose file | Preselected service file in the panel | `flashnext-tp2.yaml` |
| Radiance im

age | Image pulled by the Update-image action | `stilldeadcode/radiance` |
| Power limit (W) | Targe

t watts for the Enable-limit action | `210` |
| Use sudo | When off, commands run without sudo (the
remote user needs direct docker/AMD permissions) | on |
> ⚠️ Security: the SSH password is stored **in plaintext** on this machine at `~/.dsh/dsh-local-radi
ance-server-controller.json`. Don't use this on shared/managed machines, and keep the account's perm
roller.json`. Don't use this on shared/managed machines, and keep the account's permissions minimal.
## Troubleshooting
| Symptom | Fix |

| Errors or stale behavior after code edits | Restart the DSH app (Host module cache) |
| `sudo: a p

assword is required` | Re-save the password in the panel (sudo uses the login password) |
| Widget s
hows `-` although the service is fine | Normal during the reconnect cooldown after a server reboot/d

isconnect; recovers within ~30 s |
| A yaml file missing from the dropdown | Only plain `.yaml/.yml`

file names without `..` are listed; `common.yaml` is hidden on purpose |
| Decode reads 0/tiny whil
e idle | Radiance reports a windowed engine-side average; idle is near zero by design |
